verdict:
NO POSITION, EITHER DIRECTION - what survives this court is a calendar tripwire, not a trade.

THE SCREEN PREMISE WAS DEAD ON ARRIVAL AND THE TRIAGE SAID SO. A growth-multiple insurtech was scored against a P&C underwriting-cycle median; on the cohort's own axis the predicted damage is absent and moving the right way (GLR 60% vs 67%, record-low LAE, reinsurers ceding LESS at renewal). The -47.3% decomposes into an unexplained Jan-Jul -37% leg, a -24% print reaction with a named mechanism (revenue guide raised, EBITDA loss guide HELD, CFO succession same morning), and a +9.5% bounce. The triage refused to call the unexplained leg mispricing - correct beta-bleed discipline - and no bench ever decomposed it because IBKR was denied to every session in this record. The court closed with its largest price leg unexamined; that is a standing coverage item, not a reopened question.

WHY THERE IS NO TRADE. (1) The claimed honesty divergence dissolved on primary: H1-26 GAAP OCF of -$4.0M against -$41.7M a year ago is CONVERGING toward the marketed adjusted metric, and blue's derivation that H2-25 GAAP OCF printed +$25.2M shows H1-negative is seasonality, not masking. Under the ELEVATE boundary that is a review_flag, not a court leg. The genuinely good candidate from this record is the mechanism red extracted: the adjusted-FCF wedge equals the synthetic-agents CAC-financing flows - wire it as a detector, harvest it, but it does not indict this quarter. (2) The insider-selling thread dissolved to two officers, combined under $700k, cadence-timed, the CFO's own sale a de-minimis $118k. (3) What remains is management's Q4 hinge: the held $(47)-$(51)M FY guide implies approximately +$8M of adjusted EBITDA in Q4 after a Q3 guided WIDER - and the best single analytic move by either bench is red's reading of the July-1 cession cut (20% to 18%) as management leaning INTO that promise, retaining ~$7M/quarter more premium whose tail is exactly hurricane-season shaped, in the precise quarters the promise must land. That is a falsifiable, dated, someone-else's-promise setup - a tripwire, not an entry. (4) Direction matters and neither is available: a short into 27-30% SI is anti-doctrine (squeeze fuel, plus no premium-selling in the taxable book); a long has no verified fairness at ~3.35x FY26 guided revenue - and do not net the ~$1.2B cash into EV, it backs regulated reserves.

GATE RULING: the existing ledger gate (alert_below 46.16, 52-week-low break, informational decomposition trigger) is KEPT - it passes the beta-carrier test because LMND's drawdown is idiosyncratic (no commodity/index carrier dominates its tape) and the gate is explicitly informational. The real reopener is the calendar: confirmed Q3 print date minus 5 trading days, with the retained-cat reconstruction built BEFORE the print.
blue_ruling: SUSTAINED - the cleanest bench pair in the batch. Blue upheld red's REJECT on every substantive finding, corrected two of red's facts in ways that strengthened rather than weakened the ruling (the 07-06 Form 144 was the departing CFO Bixby's $118k, not a second Peters notice; H2-25 GAAP OCF was +$25.2M, proving GAAP already prints positive halves), and correctly inverted red's one analytic error: 27-30% short interest is squeeze fuel FOR a long, not evidence a long is priced - the conditioning gate as red deployed it is built for shorts. Both benches primary-fetched their own numbers; no unaudited correction is load-bearing, so no adjudicator re-fetch was required under doctrine.
reopen_gates: CALENDAR (primary): company PR confirming the Q3 print date -> re-court at T-minus-5 trading days with the pre-print reconstruction: state-level cat mix of the insured book x the new 18% cession, monthly retained-cat-loss estimate, and an IFP-to-earned bridge. This is the reconstruction the fema_nri_hazard detector should be re-aimed at (the book's state mix, not leased offices - both benches contested the dispatch and both are right).

DATA: Q3 print grades the hinge directly - adjusted EBITDA vs the $(20)-$(23)M Q3 guide, and any FY-guide language change. A Q3 wider than guide with the FY held makes the implied Q4 swing mathematically heroic; a FY cut is the honest exit from the promise and re-prices the name either way.
DATA: a GAAP-OCF-positive quarter PLUS short interest collapsing below ~15% - red's own revival condition for a long on an uncrowded, GAAP-confirmed axis; adopted verbatim.
EVENT: any >1%-of-holdings insider cluster post-print (the current record is two de-minimis officer sales; a real cluster changes the read).

COVERAGE (standing, needs an interactive session): decompose the Jan-Jul -37% leg from IBKR bars - the largest price move in the record remains unexamined by any bench; do it before any future entry decision, not after.
PRICE (existing ledger gate, kept): alert_below 46.16 = 52-week-low break -> triggers decomposition of the undecomposed leg, informational only, never entry.
